'''Elmra''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. He was killed by a [[Changeling/Legends|changeling]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] dispatched by remnants of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
